name: Dolanaar Delivery
summary: Travelers leave Shadowglen with a parcel of herbs bound for Dolanaar. Porthannius, occupied with the druids, asks them to carry it south, marking their first venture beyond the sheltered glade.

sections.title: A Messenger for Shadowglen
sections.body: Porthannius asks travelers heading south from Shadowglen to carry a bundle of freshly harvested herbs along the forest path. He is occupied with pressing business alongside the druids tending the glade, and cannot leave to handle the errand himself. The bundle goes south as young adventurers prepare to leave the training grounds for the wider reaches of Teldrassil.

sections.title: The Road to Dolanaar
sections.body: The southern road from Shadowglen leads to Dolanaar, a foremost night elf settlement on Teldrassil's great boughs. Innkeeper Keldamyr oversees hospitality, rest, and supplies for wanderers, sentinels, and druids. When he receives the herbs on Porthannius's behalf, he urges young adventurers to rest their minds and spirits before facing the corruption spreading across the world tree.

faq.answer: Porthannius is a night elf who lives in Shadowglen, Teldrassil's starting glade. He works with the local druids and asks travelers leaving the glade to carry supplies south for him.

faq.q: Why can't Porthannius deliver the herbs himself?
faq.answer: Urgent business with Shadowglen's druids keeps Porthannius occupied in the sheltered vale, so he relies on passing adventurers to carry the herbs south.
The package holds herbs gathered in Shadowglen for use at the inn in Dolanaar.
Innkeeper Keldamyr manages Dolanaar's inn, offering travelers hospitality, lodging, and hearthstones. He also coordinates trade and supply exchanges with other settlements across Teldrassil.
Dolanaar lies south of Shadowglen. The primary road from the glade's exit leads travelers directly to the town center.

faq.q: Why is this delivery important for young adventurers?
faq.answer: The delivery introduces young adventurers to the world beyond Shadowglen and encourages them to venture out and discover Dolanaar's inn, trainers, and service providers.

angles.text: As a night elf, this delivery marks your departure from Aldrassil's protected cradle and the beginning of broader responsibilities in safeguarding Teldrassil.
As a herbalist, you know how raw herbs from Shadowglen's soil matter to Dolanaar's healers, cooks, and caretakers.
As a druid, you know that Porthannius is occupied with Shadowglen's druids and the spiritual duties and natural imbalances that concern the Cenarion Circle among Teldrassil's boughs.
